```{r}
#| include: false
source("_setup.R")
x <- read_sf(file.path(dd, "measo_regions06.parquet"))
```

All figures on this page are made in R from the published files and the package data sets; expand
"Code" to see how.

## Colours

The colours of the MEASO Summary for Policymakers (Figure 5); see [Definition](definition.qmd#colours).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-colours
#| tbl-cap: "Fill colours by sector and zone (version 06). T regions have no colour."
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Code"
#| results: asis
colour_table <- function(x) {
cell <- function(name, fill) {
  if (is.na(fill)) return(sprintf("<td>%s</td>", name))
  rgb <- col2rgb(fill)
  fg <- if (sum(rgb * c(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)) > 140) "black" else "white"
  sprintf('<td style="background:%s;color:%s">%s<br><code style="background:none;color:%s">%s</code></td>',
          substr(fill, 1, 7), fg, name, fg, substr(fill, 1, 7))
}
zones <- c("Antarctic", "Subantarctic", "Northern", NA)
rows <- vapply(unique(x$sector), function(s) {
  d <- x[x$sector == s, ]
  cells <- vapply(zones, function(z) {
    i <- which(if (is.na(z)) is.na(d$zone) else d$zone %in% z)
    cell(d$name[i], d$fill[i])
  }, "")
  sprintf("<tr><th>%s</th>%s</tr>", s, paste(cells, collapse = ""))
}, "")
cat('<table class="table" style="text-align:center">',
    "<tr><th></th><th>Antarctic</th><th>Subantarctic</th><th>Northern</th><th>(outside)</th></tr>",
    rows, "</table>", sep = "\n")
}
colour_table(x)
```

### Version 05 colours

The colours of version 05 (`measo_names` in the R package), as released. Sectors that alternate
around the continent share a palette. The first of the two West Pacific Antarctic (WPA) rows in
`measo_names` has a different colour (an error); this table shows the second.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-colours-05
#| tbl-cap: "Fill colours by sector and zone (version 05)."
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Code"
#| results: asis
colour_table(measo_names[!duplicated(measo_names$name, fromLast = TRUE), ])
```

## Polar map

```{r}
#| label: fig-polar
#| fig-cap: "MEASO regions in the polar equal area projection, with the continent cut out."
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Code"
cst <- measo_regions06_coastline
par(mar = rep(0, 4))
plot(st_union(st_geometry(x)), col = "grey80", border = NA)  ## continent shows through
plot(st_geometry(cst), col = cst$fill, border = "grey60", lwd = 0.3, add = TRUE)
pos <- st_coordinates(suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(x))))
text(pos, x$name, cex = 0.7)
```

## Longitude/latitude map

```{r}
#| label: fig-ll
#| fig-cap: "MEASO regions in longitude/latitude. The West Pacific regions are in two parts, either side of the anti-meridian."
#| fig-height: 4
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Code"
ll <- measo_regions06_ll_coastline
par(mar = c(2.5, 2.5, 0.5, 0.5))
plot(st_geometry(ll), col = ifelse(is.na(ll$fill), "grey97", ll$fill),
     border = "grey50", axes = TRUE, xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-85, -30))
## label positions from the polar centroids
cds <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_centroid(st_geometry(measo_regions06)), 4326))
text(cds, measo_regions06$name, cex = 0.55)
```

## Sectors and zones

```{r}
#| label: fig-sector-zone
#| fig-cap: "Sectors (left, in their hues from Figure 5) and zones (right, in the zone colours of Figure 7) of the MEASO Summary for Policymakers."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Code"
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = rep(0.2, 4))
## each sector's hue (its Northern zone colour)
sec_col <- with(x[x$zone %in% "Northern", ], setNames(fill, sector))
plot(st_geometry(x), col = sec_col[x$sector], border = "white")
legend("bottomleft", legend = names(sec_col), fill = sec_col, bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
zone_col <- c(Antarctic = "#BEE7FA", Subantarctic = "#0E94AF", Northern = "#0A4F70")
plot(st_geometry(x), col = ifelse(is.na(x$zone), "grey95", zone_col[x$zone]), border = "white")
legend("bottomleft", legend = c(names(zone_col), "outside MEASO"), fill = c(zone_col, "grey95"),
       bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
par(op)
```

## Areas

Areas are calculated in the polar equal area projection, for the full regions and with the continent
cut out.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-areas
#| tbl-cap: "Region areas (million km²)."
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Code"
tab <- data.frame(name = measo_regions06$name, label = measo_regions06$label,
                  full = round(as.numeric(st_area(measo_regions06)) / 1e12, 2),
                  without_continent = round(as.numeric(st_area(measo_regions06_coastline)) / 1e12, 2))
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Plots on a map

The regions make a natural layout for small plots of data summarised by region. The
[map-patches](package/articles/map-patches.html) vignette in the R package shows one way to do this
with ggplot2 and patchwork.
